title: The complex of free presheaves of modules attached to a family is exact in positive degrees
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $X_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $\mathcal O$ a presheaf of rings on $X_{\Et}$, and $\mathcal U=\{f_i:U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ a family of morphisms of $X_{\Et}$ with fixed target. For an object $V$ let $\mathcal O_V$ be the presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] $W\mapsto\bigoplus_{\varphi\in\Mor(W,V)}\mathcal O(W)$, the restriction along $\psi:W'\to W$ sending the summand of $\varphi$ to that of $\varphi\circ\psi$ by $\mathcal O(W)\to\mathcal O(W')$ (this is $\mathbf Z_V\otimes_{p,\mathbf Z}\mathcal O$ with $\mathbf Z_V$ the free abelian presheaf on $\Mor(-,V)$); a morphism $V\to V'$ induces $\mathcal O_V\to\mathcal O_{V'}$ by composition. Let $K_\bullet=\mathcal O_{\mathcal U,\bullet}$ be the chain complex of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules with $K_p=\bigoplus_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)\in I^{p+1}}\mathcal O_{U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p}}$ for $p\geq0$, $K_p=0$ for $p<0$, whose differential $K_{p+1}\to K_p$ is $\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j$ times the map induced by the projection $U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_{p+1}}\to U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\widehat{U_{i_j}}\cdots\times_UU_{i_{p+1}}$. Then $K_\bullet$ is exact in positive degrees: for every object $W$ of $X_{\Et}$ and every $p>0$, $H_p(K_\bullet(W))=0$. (Stacks states this for any category with the fibre products $U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p}$.)
